verdict.rationale: Render documents an official Render CLI for managing services and datastores from the terminal, including validating render.yaml Blueprints, and a probe confirms the CLI docs page exists. Missing for 10: no evidence of agent-oriented CLI features such as non-interactive or JSON output modes, sparse detail on command coverage, and no independent or hands-on corroboration of CLI use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: Use the Render CLI to manage your Render services and datastores directly from your terminal
